_comment: SIH26038 Phase 3 — adaptive enhancement parameters. ALL values are ENGINEERING HEURISTICS, not clinically validated. Enhancement never runs on GOOD (bypass) or UNGRADABLE (reject) images — BORDERLINE only.

clahe.comment: Applied to the L channel of LAB only (never independent RGB, which distorts colour).

illumination.comment: Per-channel gain = channel_mean / blurred_background, clipped to gain_cap. Large median kernel estimates the slow illumination field while preserving vessels/lesions.

denoise.comment: Conservative bilateral filter (edge-preserving). Applied only when CLAHE ran (noise amplification guard) or mild global grain is detected — never aggressive smoothing (lesion safety).

color.comment: Masked gray-world with gain cap: corrects global cast, preserves relative colour differences. Triggered only when inter-channel mean spread exceeds trigger_spread.

selection.comment: quality-component status -> operations. Focus BORDERLINE is deliberately NOT sharpened: blur destroys information that enhancement cannot recover (recorded as warning instead). allow_unsharp stays false unless a future phase justifies it with tests.

sanity_checks.comment: If any check fails, the enhanced image is DISCARDED and the original retained.
